# Country scope. Orthodox or Miaphysite, as in the Roman World's orthodox_kingdom status.
oe_tw_eastern_church = {
    OR = { religion = religion:orthodox religion = religion:miaphysite }
}
# Country scope. A Byzantine subject of one of the author's middle-circle types (not a theme, not the bank).
oe_tw_mid_subject = {
    overlord ?= { tag = BYZ }
    OR = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II is_subject_type = oe_roman_march is_subject_type = oe_heg_expedition is_subject_type = oe_sub_mam is_subject_type = oe_arabian_kingdom is_subject_type = oe_black_sea_kingdom is_subject_type = oe_persian_empire is_subject_type = oe_hungarian_dominion is_subject_type = oe_german_kingdom is_subject_type = oe_german_holy_empire }
}
# Country scope. A member of the Roman World organization.
oe_tw_rw_member = {
    exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
    is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
}

# Family of kings (design 5.3; Dölger's father / son / brother / friend). Country scope, safe for any country.
# The middle-circle subject type decides first: the German and Persian empires are brothers, the others are sons when
# Orthodox or Miaphysite and friends otherwise. Then the Roman World status: prince or orthodox kingdom = son;
# every other member (Latin duchy, beylik, or no status) = friend. BYZ and the holder of Constantinople have no rank.
oe_tw_rank_brother = {
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    oe_tw_mid_subject = yes
    OR = { is_subject_type = oe_german_holy_empire is_subject_type = oe_persian_empire }
}
oe_tw_rank_son = {
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { oe_tw_mid_subject = yes }
        NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_german_holy_empire } NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_persian_empire }
        oe_tw_eastern_church = yes
    }
    trigger_else = {
        oe_tw_rw_member = yes
        NOT = { has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_byz international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
        OR = {
            has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_prince international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
            has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_orthodox_kingdom international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
        }
    }
}
oe_tw_rank_friend = {
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { oe_tw_mid_subject = yes }
        NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_german_holy_empire } NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_persian_empire }
        NOT = { oe_tw_eastern_church = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = {
        oe_tw_rw_member = yes
        NOT = { has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_byz international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
        NOT = { has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_prince international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
        NOT = { has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_roman_world_orthodox_kingdom international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world } }
    }
}
oe_tw_ranked = {
    OR = { oe_tw_rank_son = yes oe_tw_rank_brother = yes oe_tw_rank_friend = yes }
}

# Country scope. A ranked country whose adult ruler can be honoured (not the emperor himself, not at war with us).
oe_tw_grant_target_ok = {
    oe_tw_ranked = yes
    has_ruler = yes
    ruler ?= { is_adult = yes NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } }
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
}
# Country scope (BYZ). The action can be opened: enough for the cheapest dignity.
oe_tw_can_open_grant = {
    tag = BYZ
    oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes
    exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tw_need_prestige_tt prestige >= 10 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tw_need_authority_tt var:oe_pillars_authority >= 4 } }
}
# Country scope. Candidate for the AI: not honoured recently and holding no dignity.
oe_tw_ai_target = {
    oe_tw_grant_target_ok = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_cd }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled }
}

# Any scope. Fewer than 2 reigning rulers hold Despot.
oe_tw_cap_despotes = { NOT = { any_country = { count >= 2 ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } } } }
# Any scope. Fewer than 2 reigning rulers hold Sebastokrator.
oe_tw_cap_sebastokrator = { NOT = { any_country = { count >= 2 ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_sebastokrator } } } }
# Any scope. No reigning ruler holds Kaisar.
oe_tw_cap_kaisar = { NOT = { any_country = { count >= 1 ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_kaisar } } } }
# Any scope. Fewer than 3 reigning rulers hold Protosebastos.
oe_tw_cap_protosebastos = { NOT = { any_country = { count >= 3 ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_protosebastos } } } }
